Every cached .crate SHA256 equals Cargo.lock checksum. Archived .cargo_vcs_info.json provides the exact revision; every archived Cargo.toml.orig matches bytes from that revision and confirms name/version. This is a reproducible correspondence chain, not a maintainer signature or legal authentication.
SHA256 and byte lengths are of original HTTP response bytes, not reader-formatted text or Git blob IDs. Raw bytes retained privately; no third-party original text added to repository.
Archive absence remains an archive fact: finding a text upstream does not change the existing 330/16/17/6 categories. Metadata traversal is not active-build or binary inclusion proof.

requirements_by_reference.MIT_TEXT: Retrieved MIT text requires inclusion of its copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions; preserve actual upstream copyright, not a generic replacement.
requirements_by_reference.MIT_OR_APACHE_OPTION: Metadata offers alternatives. Distribution owner must select an applicable licence; MIT condition as above, or Apache-2.0 section 4 conditions including a licence copy, modified-file notices and applicable attribution preservation. Both alternatives are not automatically cumulative. Root copyright notices are not always full licence terms.
requirements_by_reference.CHROMIUM_SCOPE_OPEN: If Chromium-derived portions are distributed, the retrieved BSD-style notice requires source retention and reproduction of copyright, conditions and disclaimer in binary documentation/materials; no endorsement. Exact package/binary coverage is NOT_VERIFIED.
requirements_by_reference.ZLIB_OPTION: Retrieved Zlib terms prohibit misrepresenting origin, require plainly marking altered source versions, and forbid removing/altering the notice from source distributions. Product acknowledgement is appreciated but not required. Choice and scope remain with distribution owner.
requirements_by_reference.MIT_APACHE_TEXT_OPEN: A pinned dual-licence grant notice exists but full MIT/Apache texts were not located there; do not call that a complete-text acquisition for both alternatives.
requirements_by_reference.SLASH_DECLARATION_OPEN: Keep raw non-SPDX slash notation. MIT text acquired; Apache alternative and exact dual-licensing intent not independently established.
requirements_by_reference.ORIGINAL_TEXT_OPEN: No exact-version original copyright/permission text acquired. Resolve with upstream or the distribution responsibility owner; do not invent it.
